deploy-bot: Deploy finished to prod (us-west2 + eu1) — service=inference-runtime image=inference-runtime:v2.3.1; postdeploy smoke started; release notes https://go.redwood/release/2.3.1 :rocket:

olivia: quick smoke failing on eu1 embed probe — p95 jumped to ~1.6s and 503s seen on /embed-route
mike: i see 4x 503s in the last 3m, backend worker oom/eviction traces on eu1-rt-3
sre-julio: looks localized to eu1. prefer traffic pin to v2.3.0 instead of full rollback
release-manager: agree. pin traffic and monitor for 10m. will annotate release notes
anya: repro command: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" -H "x-route: embed" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' https://eu1.api.redwood/infer -> 503
mike: runbook command to pin: rbacctl set-route-weight inference-runtime eu1 v2.3.0 100
sre-julio: executing that now; will stream logs
sre-julio: ran `rbacctl set-route-weight inference-runtime eu1 v2.3.0 100` — routing change applied
observability-bot: [event] route-weight-change: inference-runtime eu1 -> v2.3.0 (100%); triggered by sre-julio
olivia: post-pin smoke: 200 OK, p95 ~430ms on embed, no 5xx in last 1m
release-manager: updating release notes: "eu1 pinned to v2.3.0 during post-deploy smoke due to embed probe 503s; rollback avoided; follow-up investigation opened"
anya: filing issue with heap/eviction traces and sample req ids (req_abc123, req_def456): ISSUE-4523
mike: plan: reduce model bundle memory footprint and retry canary with +20% memory headroom in 24h
sre-julio: monitoring 10m window, will escalate if errors reappear
deploy-bot: Pin recorded in deploy metadata. Marking deploy status = partial-pin :white_check_mark:
